assets.prompt: BRINE underwater station-builder environment prop. One isolated low cluster of water-worn limestone cobbles: five unequal rounded flattened stones nestled asymmetrically, one broad grey-beige stone, two medium and two small stones, sparse embedded ivory shell scars, muted olive mineral staining in shallow pits. Strongly overhead orthographic camera, broad top surfaces, very shallow south-facing relief. Tactile detailed game art with restrained natural materials, diffuse neutral lighting, quiet grey-beige palette. Distinct from sharp basalt cliffs and rusty stacked ledges. No plants, no sandy rectangular ground patch, no surrounding scenery, no text or labels, no glow, no blue water wash. Whole grounded cluster centered with generous empty margins. True transparent RGBA background including gaps between outer stones. Square native image. Intended as small seabed scenery at less than half a station room width, not a massive obstacle.
